title: Soft turkey and veggie meatballs
summary: Tender baked meatballs packed with grated veggies, cut into quarters for little eaters.
texture: Soft and moist. Cut each meatball into quarters or small pieces, or flatten slightly so it squashes easily.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking tray with parchment.
Mix everything together with clean hands until combined.
Roll into small balls, about 1 inch wide, and place on the tray.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C). Cool, then cut into quarters before serving.
choking: Cut meatballs into quarters: whole round meatballs are a choking risk for toddlers.
Don't overbake: dry meat is harder to chew and swallow.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days, or freeze cooked meatballs up to 2 months. Reheat until hot through, then cool.
tips: Serve with the lentil tomato sauce from our 10-month pasta recipe.
